dict.string: boringNotch reads the audio of the app you are playing so the notch visualiser can follow the music.
Reads the battery level of your connected Bluetooth devices, so the notch can show it. Nothing is transmitted.

macOS only reveals the name of the Wi-Fi network you are on to apps with location access. The notch uses it to show which network you just joined. Your location is never read, stored, or sent anywhere.
